hero.subtitle: Plug Microsoft (Azure AD / Entra ID) login into your app with one shared Code Exchange flow for web and mobile.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Microsoft Entra ID uses the OAuth2 Authorization Code flow (v2). After consent, the API fetches the user profile from Microsoft Graph, creates a short-lived single-use exchange code in Redis, and your client exchanges it for the same JWTs you get from password login.

console.title: Microsoft Entra admin center
console.description: Register an app in the Entra admin center → App registrations → set Redirect URI to MICROSOFT_CALLBACK_URL, create a client secret, and grant API permissions: User.Read, openid, profile, email. Use MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID=common for multi-tenant + personal Microsoft accounts, or your tenant GUID for single-tenant.

api.title: API contract
api.description: The API exposes a start URL and a callback that issues the exchange code.

codeHeader.label: Start
codeHeader.context: Redirect the user to Microsoft consent

codeHeader.label: Callback
codeHeader.context: Microsoft redirects back to the API

userModel.title: User model
userModel.description: The Azure AD object ID from Graph `/me` is stored as `microsoftId`. Email comes from `mail` or `userPrincipalName`.
